The power of elements brought agony to his mind and body. Magi'kot was not of Balance. Fire burned his eyes unto blindness, Wind put his mind into a spin, Earth entered his body and aged him like the mountains,and finally, Water washed his memories of mortal life away. Failing his test, the Orb exacted its terrible price, and now Magikot is part of the Orb.
